rationale: The EASA NPA 2025-07(B) document, as inspected and excerpted, explicitly proposes a detailed AI-trustworthiness framework. The document's title and internal sections confirm its status as a 'Notice of Proposed Amendment' and 'Proposed DS.AI', aligning with the claim's scope and status. The excerpts and inspection scope directly mention and detail provisions for 'system development assurance', 'supervised-ML learning assurance', 'configuration management' (life-cycle data), 'in-service monitoring', and 'continuous risk assessment'. Other project documents consistently describe the NPA as a 'proposed detailed civil framework' covering 'operational domain, risk assessment, system development assurance, learning assurance, configuration/life-cycle data and in-service monitoring', further supporting the claim's description of the framework's span and its role as a 'substantial candidate lifecycle'.
